auth_group.definition: CREATE TABLE "auth_group" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE)

auth_group_permissions.definition: CREATE TABLE "auth_group_permissions" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

auth_permission.definition: CREATE TABLE "auth_permission" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "codename" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL)

auth_user.definition: CREATE TABLE "auth_user" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "password" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "last_login" datetime NULL, "is_superuser" bool NOT NULL, "username" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "is_staff" bool NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "date_joined" datetime NOT NULL, "first_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL)

auth_user_groups.definition: CREATE TABLE "auth_user_groups" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

auth_user_user_permissions.definition: CREATE TABLE "auth_user_user_permissions" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_accountevent.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_accountevent" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "action" varchar(24) NOT NULL, "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "account_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_treatmentaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_allocation.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_allocation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "amount" decimal NOT NULL, "installment_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_installment" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "entry_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_ledgerentry" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_installment_entry" UNIQUE ("installment_id", "entry_id"))

clinic_appointment.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_appointment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "starts_at" datetime NOT NULL, "ends_at" datetime NOT NULL, "purpose" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "notes" text NOT NULL, "status" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "arrived_at" datetime NULL, "queue_at" datetime NULL, "is_walk_in" bool NOT NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "created_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "appointment_valid_times" CHECK ("ends_at" > ("starts_at")))

clinic_attachment.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_attachment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "teeth" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("teeth") OR "teeth" IS NULL)), "area" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "category" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "title" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "taken_on" date NULL, "uploaded_at" datetime NOT NULL, "storage_name" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "thumbnail_name" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "content_type" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "size" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("size" >= 0), "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "uploader_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_auditevent.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_auditevent" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "occurred_at" datetime NOT NULL, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "object_id" bigint unsigned NULL CHECK ("object_id" >= 0), "object_type" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "action" varchar(32) NOT NULL)

clinic_clinicprintsettings.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_clinicprintsettings" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "address" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "contact" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0))

clinic_correctionrequest.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_correctionrequest" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "status" varchar(12) NOT NULL, "decided_at" datetime NULL, "decision_reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "decided_by_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "requested_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "original_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_ledgerentry" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "account_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_treatmentaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_expense.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_expense" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "spent_on" date NOT NULL, "category" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "description" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "amount" decimal NOT NULL, "method" varchar(12) NOT NULL, "reference" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "recorded_at" datetime NOT NULL, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "original_id" bigint NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "clinic_expense" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "expense_positive_amount" CHECK ("amount" > '0'))

clinic_financiallock.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_financiallock" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "revision" bigint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0))

clinic_installment.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_installment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "amount" decimal NOT NULL, "due_on" date NULL, "notes" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "schedule_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_schedule" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "installment_positive_amount" CHECK ("amount" > '0'))

clinic_ledgerentry.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_ledgerentry" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" varchar(12) NOT NULL, "amount" decimal NOT NULL, "description" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "method" varchar(12) NOT NULL, "payment_reference" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "reference" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "received_at" datetime NOT NULL, "recorded_at" datetime NOT NULL, "balance_after" decimal NOT NULL, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "plan_item_id" bigint NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "clinic_planitem" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "account_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_treatmentaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "original_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_ledgerentry" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "ledger_positive_amount" CHECK ("amount" > '0'), CONSTRAINT "ledger_nonnegative_balance" CHECK ("balance_after" >= '0'))

clinic_loginattempt.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_loginattempt" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "key" varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "failures" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("failures" >= 0), "window_started" datetime NOT NULL)

clinic_medicalreview.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_medicalreview" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "snapshot" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("snapshot") OR "snapshot" IS NULL)), "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" datetime NOT NULL, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "reviewed_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_patient.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_patient" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "number" varchar(16) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "full_name" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "phone" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "whatsapp" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "date_of_birth" date NULL, "approximate_age" smallint unsigned NULL CHECK ("approximate_age" >= 0), "age_recorded_on" date NULL, "address" text NOT NULL, "occupation" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "emergency_contact" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "medical_history" text NOT NULL, "current_medicines" text NOT NULL, "allergies" text NOT NULL, "medical_alerts" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "created_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_performedwork.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_performedwork" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "procedure_label" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "teeth" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("teeth") OR "teeth" IS NULL)), "area" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "notes" text NOT NULL, "performed_at" datetime NOT NULL, "author_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "plan_item_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_planitem" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "procedure_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_procedure" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_personaltask.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_personaltask" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "notes" text NOT NULL, "due_at" datetime NULL, "completed_at" datetime NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "creator_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_planitem.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_planitem" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "teeth" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("teeth") OR "teeth" IS NULL)), "area" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "notes" text NOT NULL, "status" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "target_date" date NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "procedure_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_procedure" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "plan_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_treatmentplan" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_planrevision.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_planrevision" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "snapshot" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("snapshot") OR "snapshot" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "author_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "plan_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_treatmentplan" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_prescriberprofile.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_prescriberprofile" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "display_name" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "qualifications" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "registration" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "contact" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "user_id" integer NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_prescription.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_prescription" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "prescribed_on" date NOT NULL, "medications" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("medications") OR "medications" IS NULL)), "advice" text NOT NULL, "follow_up" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "issued_at" datetime NULL, "snapshot" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("snapshot") OR "snapshot" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "prescriber_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_prescriptioncorrection.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_prescriptioncorrection" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "original_id" bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "clinic_prescription" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "replacement_id" bigint NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "clinic_prescription" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_procedure.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_procedure" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(160) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" text NOT NULL, "active" bool NOT NULL, "is_example" bool NOT NULL)

clinic_schedule.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_schedule" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "account_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_treatmentaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_toothobservation.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_toothobservation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "teeth" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("teeth") OR "teeth" IS NULL)), "area" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "observation" text NOT NULL, "observed_at" datetime NOT NULL, "author_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_treatmentaccount.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_treatmentaccount" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "reference" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "closed_at" datetime NULL, "created_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_treatmentplan.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_treatmentplan" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "notes" text NOT NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "created_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_visit.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_visit" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "visit_at" datetime NOT NULL, "chief_complaint" text NOT NULL, "examination" text NOT NULL, "diagnosis" text NOT NULL, "teeth" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("teeth") OR "teeth" IS NULL)), "area" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "planned_treatment" text NOT NULL, "performed_treatment" text NOT NULL, "advice" text NOT NULL, "remaining_work" text NOT NULL, "follow_up" date NULL, "status" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "revision" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "completed_at" datetime NULL, "clinician_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "medical_review_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_medicalreview" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_visitamendment.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_visitamendment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "content" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "author_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "visit_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "clinic_visit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_workflowevent.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_workflowevent" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "token" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "action" varchar(32) NOT NULL, "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL, "before" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("before") OR "before" IS NULL)), "after" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("after") OR "after" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "actor_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "appointment_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_appointment" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "patient_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_patient" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "prescription_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_prescription" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "task_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "clinic_personaltask" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

clinic_workflowlock.definition: CREATE TABLE "clinic_workflowlock" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "revision" bigint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("revision" >= 0))

django_content_type.definition: CREATE TABLE "django_content_type" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app_label" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "model" varchar(100) NOT NULL)

django_migrations.definition: CREATE TABLE "django_migrations" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "applied" datetime NOT NULL)

django_session.definition: CREATE TABLE "django_session" ("session_key" varchar(40) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "session_data" text NOT NULL, "expire_date" datetime NOT NULL)
